description: ONE THING THE OPERATION DOES THAT COSTS MONEY — spraying, pruning, irrigating, harvesting, packing. The unit of activity-based costing, and the reason ABC exists: overhead does not belong to a block, it belongs to an ACTIVITY, and the activity belongs to blocks in proportion to how much of it each one consumed. `cost_driver` is what that proportion is measured in and is the most consequential field here — it decides how every dollar in this activity's pool reaches a block. `phase` places the activity on the Growing → Harvest → Post-Harvest → Packing → Sales waterfall, which is how cost per unit is watched accumulating rather than only totalled at the end.

fields.description: What this is called on the ground — 'Dormant spray', 'Hand thinning', 'Pick and haul'. Free text: half of what a farm costs is an activity that is not an Item on anybody's site.
fields.label: Activity

fields.description: What KIND of work this is. Grouping only — it changes no arithmetic. `phase` is the field that moves money along the waterfall.

fields.description: Where this activity sits on the production pipeline. THE ORDER IS THE POINT: a bin leaves the block carrying its growing cost, picks up harvest cost, then post-harvest, then packing, then sales — and `get_phase_waterfall` reads cumulative cost per unit at each of those five points. An activity in the wrong phase does not lose money from the total; it reports the cost as arriving at the wrong moment, which is worse, because the whole use of the waterfall is deciding where cost enters.
fields.label: Phase

fields.description: WHAT THIS ACTIVITY'S COST IS DIVIDED BY. The single most consequential field on the doctype: it decides how every dollar in the pool reaches a block. Only two drivers are DERIVABLE from what this site already holds — Acres (from each Field's acreage, weighted by the days it was productive in the year) and Direct Assignment (the pool names its own cost object). Every other driver is a measurement somebody took, and `compute_abc_allocation` requires it to be supplied rather than estimating it: an activity whose driver quantities are unknown is reported UNALLOCATED with its amount, never spread evenly across blocks, because an even spread is indistinguishable in the output from a measured one.
fields.label: Cost Driver
